title: Notification regarding Division Bench and Single Bench matters of Hon'ble Chief Justice & Hon'ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh.
text:
KEY LINES:

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 22-d July, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/
and litigants that:-
: it is informed to all learned members of the Bar
(i) Division Bench shall be of Hon’ble the Chief Justice and Hon’ble Mr. Justice A.
Bimol Singh on 23-07-2026; and
(ii) Single Bench matters of Hon’ble the Chief Justice and Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Birnol
Singh to bq listed on 23-07-2026 will be taken up on the same day before the
Single Bench of Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma for fixing dates,
extension of interim orders as well as for taking up urgent matters.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(KH. AJIT SINGH)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ I aDIL+– 3 2 Imphal, the 22"d July, 2026
